From Hoxie to March Madness.

content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Sports in Kansas's PostSports in Kansas is in Hoxie, KS.March 22 at 3:30 AM · Shared with PublicFrom Hoxie to March Madness.Jacie Hoyt, a Hoxie High School graduate, earned her first NCAA Tournament win as a head coach Saturday night, leading Oklahoma State Cowgirls to an 82-68 victory over Princeton Tigers women’s basketball.In her fourth season at Oklahoma State, Hoyt has the Cowgirls at 24-9, earning an 8-seed and delivering a milestone win on the national stage.Hoyt’s path started in Hoxie, where she was one of the top players in the state: • Three-time all-state athlete • 2,000+ career points • Averaged 26+ points per game • Senior season: 28 points, 7 assists, 6 rebounds, 6 steals per gameShe also comes from one of the most respected coaching families in Kansas. Her mother, Shelly Hoyt, is a longtime Kansas coaching legend.Hoyt went on to play at Colby Community College and Wichita State University, starting every game her final two seasons and graduating magna cum laude.Her coaching journey:Fort Hays State → Nevada → Kansas State → Kansas City → now Oklahoma StateNow she’s winning in March.Kansas roots. Proven leader.
